data.long_meaning: In Greek mythology, Helios was the god of the sun. Sollie is a derivative of the Greek name Helia, which means sun goddess. The name Sollie carries the meaning “Sun Goddess” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Sollie usually hope their child will grow to embody sun goddess and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Sollie total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

This connection to the sun brings a sense of light, warmth, and energy to the name Sollie. It also suggests a strong connection to nature and the passage of time.
data.spiritual_significance: In a spiritual context, the name Sollie represents the concept of divine light and renewal. Just as the sun rises each day to bring new life and energy, the name Sollie can serve as a reminder of the power of spiritual light and the hope it brings to our lives. It can also represent the idea of personal illumination, as the name suggests a deep inner wisdom and understanding. Overall, Sollie is a name that embodies the transformative power of the divine and the eternal light of the soul.
